items.title: Oak Ridge Boys’ Richard Sterban, Whose Distinctive Bass Voice Powered ‘Elvira’ and Other Country Smashes, Dies at 83
items.title_zh: 橡树岭男孩乐队的Richard Sterban去世，享年83岁，他的独特低音嗓音为《Elvira》和其他乡村热门歌曲注入了活力
items.summary: Richard Sterban, the bass vocalist of the Oak Ridge Boys, died Saturday in Hendersonville, Tenn., following complications from bronchitis and pneumonia after a battle with cancer. He was 83. Both his family and the band announced his death.
items.summary_zh: 橡树岭男孩乐队（Oak Ridge Boys）的低音歌手理查德·斯特班（Richard Sterban）在与癌症抗争后因支气管炎和肺炎并发症于周六在田纳西州亨德森维尔去世。他享年83岁。他的家人和乐队都宣布了他的死讯。

items.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.title_zh: Nvidia 的安全团队在哪里？
items.summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday…
items.summary_zh: 英伟达的安全主管已于8月份悄然离职，而今首席执行官黄仁勋也因其人际关系而辞职，其中包括与一家涉嫌向中国输送芯片的公司的某位高管的关系。一位前情报官员表示，这类泄密事件每天都在发生……

items.title: Inside the First AI Music Awards, a Chaotic Evening Attempting to Normalize Tech-Assisted Tunes
items.title_zh: 首届人工智能音乐奖颁奖典礼幕后：一个试图将科技辅助音乐常态化的混乱之夜
items.summary: I knew things were a little off when the first thing I heard on my walk to the AI Music Awards was “the winner…” followed by the sweet voice of Kelly Clarkson.
items.summary_zh: 当我走向AI音乐奖颁奖典礼时，听到的第一句话是“获奖者……”，然后是凯莉·克拉克森（Kelly Clarkson）甜美的声音，我就知道事情有点不对劲。

items.title: Nationwide ground stop followed contractor upgrade to L3Harris telecommunication system: DOT’s Duffy
items.title_zh: 在承包商升级至L3Harris电信系统后，全国范围内实施地面停飞：美国交通部Duffy
items.summary: The FAA ground stop came after updates to an older communication system managed by L3Harris Technologies, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Saturday.
items.summary_zh: 美国交通部长肖恩·达菲周六表示，FAA的地面停飞令是在L3Harris Technologies管理的一个旧通信系统更新后下达的。

items.title: SpaceX catches upper stage of Starship rocket in historic first
items.title_zh: SpaceX首次成功捕获星舰火箭上级，创造历史
items.summary: Starship Test Flight 15 marked the first time Elon Musk's company tried to catch both the booster and upper stage of the rocket.
items.summary_zh: 星际飞船第15次试飞标志着埃隆·马斯克的公司首次尝试同时回收火箭助推器和二级火箭。

items.title: $180 million Van Gogh tests the art market and collector confidence
items.title_zh: 价值1.8亿美元的梵高作品考验着艺术市场和收藏家的信心
items.summary: The art auctions in New York next week could top $2 billion, as a treasure trove of masterpieces comes to the market for the first time in decades.
items.summary_zh: 下周在纽约举行的艺术品拍卖会成交额可能超过20亿美元，因为数十年来首次有大量杰作进入市场。

items.title: Watch SpaceX successfully execute the first ‘chopstick’ catch of Starship
items.title_zh: 观看SpaceX成功实施星际飞船的首次“筷子”式捕捉
items.summary: After aborting a planned catch of Starship Flight 15's booster, SpaceX successfully captured Starship with its "Mechazilla" launch and catch tower for the first time.
items.summary_zh: 在中止星舰第15次飞行助推器的计划捕获后，SpaceX首次成功地用其“Mechazilla”发射和捕获塔捕获了星舰。

items.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克和其他科技公司高管签署请愿书，呼吁英伟达恢复黄仁勋的职位
items.summary: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.
items.summary_zh: 截至周六下午，该请愿书已获得超过11.5万个签名。

items.title: Saved for Sunday: Crib notes on the decline of David Jones
items.title_zh: 留到周日：关于David Jones衰落的备忘录
items.summary: When was the last time you spent a Sunday browsing in a department store? This week, business editor Jonathan Barrett talks to me about the ongoing woes at David Jones and how much saving it could cost Want Saved for Sunday in your inbox every weekend?
items.summary_zh: 您上一次在百货商场逛街是什么时候？本周，商业编辑Jonathan Barrett与我聊了聊David Jones持续存在的困境，以及拯救它可能需要付出多大的代价。想每个周末在您的收件箱中收到《Saved for Sunday》吗？

items.title: The moment I knew: He quoted my favourite TV show on our first date. I blurted out, ‘Marry me!’
items.title_zh: 我确定的那一刻：在我们的第一次约会中，他引用了我最喜欢的电视剧。我脱口而出：“嫁给我吧！”
items.summary: When Anthony Ashdown met Jake, their shared love of nerd culture felt revolutionary. Then Jake recited a line from The Golden Girls Find more stories from the moment I knew series Picture it. Sydney. 2015. I had weathered a nasty breakup the previous year.
items.summary_zh: 当Anthony Ashdown遇见Jake时，他们对极客文化的共同热爱让他们感到一种颠覆性的冲击。然后，Jake背诵了《欢乐俏佳人》中的一句台词。查看「我一见钟情的时刻」系列中的更多故事。想象一下。悉尼。2015 年。前一年，我经历了一次痛苦的分手。
